---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest new content, a section, a translation, or an improvement
title: "[FEATURE] "

---

**What gap would this fill?**
A clear description of what is missing, or could be clearer or stronger.

**What would you like to see?**
The content, section, translation, or change you are proposing.

**Does this fit the project's scope?**
Please check the "What this is NOT" section in the README before submitting, so the project stays focused. Briefly explain why this fits.

**Alternatives considered**
Any other approaches you thought about.
